info.description: Site-wide business info used across every page (phone, email, address, socials)

leadNotifyEmails.description: Comma-separated list of emails to notify when a quote/contact form is submitted (e.g. admin@..., sales@...). Falls back to the LEAD_NOTIFY_EMAIL env var if left blank.

gtmId.description: Google Tag Manager container ID (e.g. GTM-XXXXXXX). Leave blank to not load GTM at all.

turnstileSiteKey.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key (public, safe to expose to the browser). From Cloudflare dashboard > Turnstile > Add site. Leave blank to skip Turnstile on the forms entirely.

turnstileSecretKey.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key. Private: never returned by the public API, only readable from backend code. Must be set together with the site key above.
